sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret. “Cosi Cosa.” Victor, Katalog-Nr. 4381, side marked B, 1938. The description gives the recording date as 13 January 1938 and identifies the side as the version Jones sang in the MGM film „Everybody Sings“, three years after he introduced the song in „A Night at the Opera“. Discographic detail as given in the uploader's description; the label is not shown in the YouTube upload.

sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones, vocal; orchestra conducted by Georgie Stoll; orchestration by Maurice DePackh. “A Message from the Man in the Moon (from A Day at the Races)”, outtake, 2006 remaster. On That's Entertainment: The Ultimate Soundtrack Anthology of MGM Musicals; phonogram right 1937 Turner Entertainment Co.; distributed by WaterTower Music. The number was recorded for the film but cut before release. Credits as supplied by the rights holder to the distributing channel. Accessed 21 August 2026.
